671. PROCEDURE EmitScopeTable (doEmit : BOOLEAN := FALSE): INTEGER =
672.   VAR
673.     Align := MAX (Target.Address.align, Target.Integer.align);
674.     f: FramePtr := all_frames;
675.     base, x, size, e_offset: INTEGER;
676.     e_base: CG.Var;
677.   BEGIN
678.     (* the default is to not emit the scope table now we can
679.        generate gcc_exception tables. *)
680.     IF NOT doEmit THEN RETURN -1; END;
681.     IF (f = NIL) OR (NOT Target.Has_stack_walker) THEN RETURN -1; END;
682. 
683.     (* make sure that all the exception lists were declared *)
684.     WHILE (f # NIL) DO
685.       IF (f.e_set # NIL) THEN ESet.Declare (f.e_set) END;
686.       f := f.next;
687.     END;
688. 
689.     (* declare space for the table *)
690.     size := n_frames * M3RT.EX_SIZE;
691.     base := Module.Allocate (size, Align, TRUE, "*exception scopes*");
692.     CG.Comment (base, TRUE, "exception scopes");
693. 
694.     (* fill in the table *)
695.     f := all_frames;
696.     x := base;
697.     WHILE (f # NIL) DO
698.       CG.Init_intt  (x + M3RT.EX_class, Target.Char.size, RT_Kind [f.kind], TRUE);
699.       IF (f.outermost) THEN
700.         CG.Init_intt  (x + M3RT.EX_outermost, Target.Char.size, ORD(TRUE), TRUE);
701.       END;
702.       IF (f.next = NIL) THEN
703.         CG.Init_intt  (x + M3RT.EX_end_of_list, Target.Char.size, ORD(TRUE), TRUE);
704.       END;
705.       CG.Init_label (x + M3RT.EX_start, f.start, TRUE);
706.       CG.Init_label (x + M3RT.EX_stop, f.stop, TRUE);
707.       IF (f.info # NIL) THEN CG.Init_offset (x + M3RT.EX_offset, f.info, TRUE) END;
708.       IF (f.e_set # NIL) THEN
709.         ESet.GetAddress (f.e_set, e_base, e_offset);
710.         IF (e_base # NIL) OR (e_offset # 0) THEN
711.           CG.Init_var (x + M3RT.EX_excepts, e_base, e_offset, TRUE);
712.         END;
713.       END;
714.       INC (x, M3RT.EX_SIZE);
715.       f := f.next;
716.     END;
717. 
718.     RETURN base;
719.   END EmitScopeTable;
720. 
721. PROCEDURE EmitExceptionTest (signature: Type.T;  need_value: BOOLEAN): CG.Val =
722.   VAR
723.     i: INTEGER;
724.     value  : CG.Val := NIL;
725.     result := ProcType.CGResult (signature);
726.     (** ex := ProcType.Raises (signature); **)
727.   BEGIN
728.     IF need_value THEN value := CaptureResult (result); END;
729. 
730.     IF NOT Target.Has_stack_walker THEN  RETURN value;  END;
731. 
732.     (** nope -- any procedure could raise an <*IMPLICIT*> exception 
733.     IF ESet.RaisesNone (ex) THEN  RETURN value;  END;
734.     ***)
735. 
736.     (* scan the frame stack looking for the first active handler *)
737.     i := tos - 1;
738.     LOOP
739.       IF (i < 0) THEN  RETURN value;  END;
740.       WITH z = stack[i] DO
741.         CASE z.kind OF
742.         | Kind.zTRYELSE     => EXIT;
743.         | Kind.zFINALLYPROC => (* ignore the runtime does it *)
744.         | Kind.zFINALLY     => EXIT;
745.         | Kind.zLOCK        => (* ignore *)
746.         | Kind.zEXIT        => (* ignore *)
747.         | Kind.zTRY         => EXIT;
748.         | Kind.zRAISES      => (* ignore *)
749.         | Kind.zPROC        => RETURN value;  (* no relevent handlers *)
750.         END;
751.       END;
752.       DEC (i);
753.     END;
754. 
755.     IF NOT need_value THEN
756.       value := CaptureResult (result);
757.     END;
758. 
759.     (* generate the conditional branch to the handler *)
760.     (* Dont really need this code after every call - to check if an exception
761.        raised. It only works with the old copy exception model.
762.  
763.     CG.Load_addr (stack[i].info, M3RT.EA_exception, Target.Address.align);
764.     CG.Load_nil ();
765.     CG.If_compare (CG.Type.Addr, CG.Cmp.NE, stack[i].stop, CG.Never);
766.     *)
767.     IF NOT need_value AND (value # NIL) THEN
768.       CG.Push (value);
769.       CG.Free (value);
770.       value := NIL;
771.     END;
772. 
773.     RETURN value;
774.   END EmitExceptionTest;
775. 
776. PROCEDURE CaptureResult (result: CG.Type): CG.Val =
777.   BEGIN
778.     IF (result = CG.Type.Void) THEN
779.       RETURN NIL;
780.     ELSIF (result # CG.Type.Struct) THEN
781.       RETURN CG.Pop ();
782.     ELSE
783.       CG.Discard (result);
784.       RETURN NIL;
785.     END;
786.   END CaptureResult;
787. 
788. PROCEDURE NextHandler (VAR(*OUT*) handler: CG.Label;
789.                        VAR(*OUT*) handler_body: CG.Label;
790.                        VAR(*OUT*) info: CG.Var): BOOLEAN =
791.   VAR i: INTEGER;
792.   BEGIN
793.     IF NOT Target.Has_stack_walker THEN RETURN FALSE END;
794. 
795.     (* scan the frame stack looking for the first active handler *)
796.     i := tos - 1;
797.     LOOP
798.       IF (i < 0) THEN RETURN FALSE END;
799.       WITH z = stack[i] DO
800.         CASE z.kind OF
801.         | Kind.zTRYELSE     => EXIT;
802.         | Kind.zFINALLYPROC => (* ignore the runtime does it *)
803.         | Kind.zFINALLY     => EXIT;
804.         | Kind.zLOCK        => (* ignore *)
805.         | Kind.zEXIT        => (* ignore *)
806.         | Kind.zTRY         => EXIT;
807.         | Kind.zRAISES      => (* ignore *)
808.         | Kind.zPROC        => RETURN FALSE;  (* didn't find any handlers *)
809.         END;
810.       END;
811.       DEC (i);
812.     END;
813. 
814.     handler_body := stack[i].stopBody;
815.     handler := stack[i].stop;
816.     info := stack[i].info;
817.     RETURN TRUE;
818.   END NextHandler;
819. 
820. PROCEDURE Excepts() : ESet.EList =
821.   VAR i: INTEGER; e,t,ret : ESet.EList := NIL;
822.   BEGIN
823.     IF NOT Target.Has_stack_walker THEN RETURN NIL END;
824. 
825.     (* scan the frame stack getting each frames list of handled exceptions *)
826.     i := tos - 1;
827.     WHILE (i >= 0) DO
828.       e := ESet.ListE(stack[i].e_set);
829.       IF e # NIL THEN
830.         t := e;
831.         WHILE t.next # NIL DO t := t.next; END;
832.         t.next := ret;
833.         ret := e;
834.       END;
835.       DEC (i);
836.     END;
837.     RETURN ret;
838.   END Excepts;
839. 
840. (*----------------------------------------------------------------- misc. ---*)

326.     END;

328.       oc := Stmt.Compile (p.body);
329.     Marker.Pop ();

333.     END;
334. 
335.     IF (p.hasElse) THEN
336.       (* EXITs and RETURNs from the body are caught by the ELSE clause *)
337.       oc := oc - Stmt.Outcomes {Stmt.Outcome.Returns, Stmt.Outcome.Exits};
338.     END;
339. 
340.     (* check for enclosing handlers *)
341.     another := Marker.NextHandler (next_handler, handler_body, next_info);
342.

347.     Scanner.offset := p.h_origin;

<sub>⏱️ 2513m 5s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

Now I have the full picture. This is an excellent question that gets to the heart of the architecture.

### What m3front actually generates with `Has_stack_walker = TRUE`

The machinery is complete and correct. Looking at `TryStmt.Compile1` and `Procedure.EmitCall`:

```
Start_try()
  Invoke_direct(proc, result_type, handler_label)   ← not Call_direct
  ...
  Invoke_direct(other_proc, ..., handler_label)
  Jump(done)
Set_label(handler_label, barrier=TRUE)
  Landing_pad(handler_label, catches[uid1, uid2...]) → pushes exception ptr
  Store_addr(info)                                  ← save activation ref
  ... handler body (type-checks info.exception.uid) ...
End_try()
```

So m3front generates exactly the right M3CG operations — each call inside a TRY block becomes `invoke_direct(proc, result, handler)` carrying the handler label, and `landing_pad(handler, [uid...])` returns the exception activation record pointer. The information is all there.

### Why M3C.m3 ignores it

`invoke_direct` drops `handler` and just calls `call_direct`. `landing_pad` pushes `0`. These are stubs because the C backend was written assuming setjmp-based EH. The M3CG spec always had these operations for the GCC backend (`m3cc`) which generates proper GCC IR with `invoke` instructions that cause GCC to emit DWARF EH tables natively.

### The fundamental problem

M3 exceptions are raised by `RTException__Raise()`, a C function. It currently pushes onto the setjmp frame chain. **It does not throw a C++ exception.** So if you wrap a call site as:

```c
try { result = SomeProc(args); } catch (...) { goto handler; }
```

...the `catch` never fires for M3 exceptions, because `RTException__Raise` doesn't `throw`.

### The two viable paths

**Path 1 — C++ exception bridging (full EH tables, full bootstrap required):**

1. Define a thin C++ wrapper class in the M3C.m3 preamble:
   ```cpp
   struct _M3Exc { void *act; };
   ```
2. Change `RTException__Raise(act)` to `throw _M3Exc{act}` instead of longjmp
3. Implement `invoke_direct` in M3C.m3 to emit:
   ```cpp
   try { result = proc(args); } catch (_M3Exc& _e) { _m3act = _e.act; goto handler; }
   ```
4. Implement `landing_pad` to return `_m3act` (the activation record pointer) — which is exactly what m3front expects (`CG.Landing_pad` result = ADDRESS of activation)
5. `start_try`/`end_try` become no-ops (the try/catch structure handles it)

This gives clang full visibility into the EH regions → generates DWARF `.eh_frame` + `.gcc_except_table` LSDA automatically. `RTEHScan` can then scan the LSDA, and `unw_resume()` jumps to the landing pad. **Full bootstrap required** since every `.o` file compiled from M3-generated C needs recompilation with the new try/catch structure.

**Path 2 — libunwind for backtraces only, keep ex_frame for dispatch (no bootstrap):**

This abandons `ex_stack` entirely for exception dispatch and keeps setjmp-based `ex_frame`. Instead, add a separate libunwind-based backtrace capability — a new `RTBacktrace` module or similar — that's independent of the exception handling path. This works today without any compiler changes.

### Recommendation

Path 1 is architecturally correct and directly exploits the m3front machinery you pointed at. The key change is confined:
- `m3back/M3C.m3`: implement `invoke_direct`/`landing_pad` (~50 lines each)
- `m3-libs/m3core/src/runtime/common/RTException.m3`: change `RTException__Raise` to C++ `throw _M3Exc{act}`
- `m3-libs/m3core/src/runtime/ARM64_DARWIN/RTStackC.c`: already written and correct
- Enable `M3_USE_STACK_WALKER = TRUE` in the config

The bootstrap is unavoidable but straightforward: rebuild everything with the updated `m3back`, then the resulting binaries have proper EH tables and libunwind works.

Path 2 is achievable today and is a reasonable intermediate step while Path 1 is developed.

Which direction would you like to pursue?

33.     err := RuntimeError.Self ();
34.     arg := LOOPHOLE (ORD (ArgMap [raises]), ADDRESS);
35.     not_arg := LOOPHOLE (ORD (ArgMap [NOT raises]), ADDRESS);
36.   BEGIN
37.     IF (a.exception = err) AND (a.arg = arg) THEN
38.       (* We're already raising the "Unhandled exception" exception! *)
39.       Crash (a, raises, err);
40.     ELSIF (a.exception = err) AND (a.arg = not_arg) THEN
41.       Crash (a, NOT raises, err);
42.     ELSE
43.       a.un_except := a.exception;
44.       a.un_arg    := a.arg;
45.       a.exception := err;
46.       a.arg       := arg;
47.       Raise (a);
48.     END;
49.   END DefaultBackstop;

93.           WHILE (ex^ # 0) DO
94.             IF (ex^ = act.exception.uid) THEN ResumeRaise (act) END;
95.             INC (ex, ADRSIZE (ex^));
96.           END;
97.       | ORD (ScopeKind.ExceptElse) =>
98.           (* 's' is a TRY-EXCEPT-ELSE frame => go for it *)
99.           ResumeRaise (act);
100.       | ORD (ScopeKind.Finally),
101.         ORD (ScopeKind.FinallyProc),
102.         ORD (ScopeKind.Lock) =>
103.           (* ignore for this pass *)
104.       | ORD (ScopeKind.Raises) =>
105.           IF (act.exception.implicit = 0) THEN
106.             (* check that this procedure does indeed raise 'en' *)
107.             ex := LOOPHOLE (f, PF3).raises;
108.             IF ex = NIL THEN InvokeBackstop (act, raises := TRUE); END;
109.             LOOP
110.               IF (ex^ = 0) THEN  InvokeBackstop (act, raises := TRUE) END;
111.               IF (ex^ = act.exception.uid)  THEN  (* ok, it passes *) EXIT  END;
112.               INC (ex, ADRSIZE (ex^));
113.             END;
114.           END;
115.       | ORD (ScopeKind.RaisesNone) =>
116.           IF (act.exception.implicit = 0) THEN

118.           END;
119.       ELSE
120.         BadStack ();

7851.     ELSIF direct THEN (* TODO? No casts for indirect calls? *)
7852.       (* Fix for setjmp. *)
7853.       IF index = 0 AND self.proc_being_called.is_setjmp THEN
7854.         t1 := "*(jmp_buf*)"
7855.       ELSE
7856.         WITH param = types[index] DO
7857.           IF param.cgtype # CGType.Struct OR param.typeid = UID_ADDR THEN
7858.             t1 := " (";
7859.             (* TODO type.text *)
7860.             t2 := " " & param.type_text;
7861.             t3 := " )(";
7862.             t4 := " )";
7863.           END;
7864.         END;
7865.       END;
7866.       INC(index);
7867.     END;
7868.     proc := proc & comma & t1 & t2 & t3 & NARROW (values.remlo(), Expr_t).CText () & t4;
7869.     IF abort_in_call THEN
7870.       comma := ";\n ";
7871.     ELSE
7872.       comma := ",\n ";
7873.     END;
7874.   END;
7875.   self.proc_being_called := self.dummy_proc;
7876.   self.in_proc_call := FALSE; (* call cannot be nested *)
7877.   IF abort_in_call THEN
7878.     print(self, proc & ";\n");
7879.   ELSIF type = CGType.Void THEN
7880.     print(self, proc & ");\n"); (* print, do not push *)
7881.   ELSE
7882.     push(self, type, CTextToExpr(proc & ")"));
7883.   END;
7884. END call_helper;
7885. 
7886. PROCEDURE get_static_link(self: T; target: Proc_t): Expr_t =
7887. VAR target_level := target.level;
7888.     current := self.current_proc;
7889.     current_level := current.level;
7890.     static_link := "";
7891.     e: Expr_t := NIL;
7892. BEGIN
7893.     IF debug THEN
7894.       self.comment("get_static_link");
7895.     END;
7896.     IF target_level = 0 THEN
7897.         RETURN CTextToExpr ("((ADDRESS)0)");
7898.     END;
7899.     IF current_level = target_level THEN
7900.         RETURN CTextToExpr ("_static_link");
7901.     END;
7902.     IF current_level < target_level THEN
7903.         RETURN CTextToExpr ("&_frame");
7904.     END;
7905.     static_link := "_frame._static_link";
7906.     WHILE current_level > target_level DO
7907.         static_link := static_link & "->_static_link";
7908.         DEC(current_level);
7909.     END;
7910.     e := CTextToExpr(static_link);
7911.     e.cgtype := CGType.Addr; (* TODO better typing *)
7912.     RETURN e;
7913. END get_static_link;
7914. 
7915. PROCEDURE call_direct(self: T; p: M3CG.Proc; type: CGType) =
7916. (* call the procedure identified by M3CG.Proc p. The procedure
7917.    returns a value of type type. *)
7918. VAR proc := NARROW(p, Proc_t);
7919. BEGIN
7920.     IF debug_verbose THEN
7921.         self.comment("call_direct type:", cgtypeToText [type]);
7922.     ELSIF debug THEN
7923.       self.comment("call_direct");
7924.     END;
7925. 
7926.     <* ASSERT self.in_proc_call *>
7927. 
7928.     IF proc.level # 0 THEN
7929.         self.params.addhi(get_static_link(self, proc));
7930.     END;
7931. 
7932.     call_helper(self, type, NameT(proc.name));
7933. END call_direct;
7934. 
7935. PROCEDURE call_indirect(self: T; type: CGType; <*UNUSED*>callingConvention: CallingConvention) =
7936. (* call the procedure whose address is in s0.A and pop s0. The
7937.    procedure returns a value of type type. *)
7938. VAR s0 := get(self, 0);
7939.     static_link := self.static_link;
7940.     param_types: TEXT := NIL;
```

788. PROCEDURE NextHandler (VAR(*OUT*) handler: CG.Label;
789.                        VAR(*OUT*) handler_body: CG.Label;
790.                        VAR(*OUT*) info: CG.Var): BOOLEAN =
791.   VAR i: INTEGER;
792.   BEGIN
793.     IF NOT Target.Has_stack_walker THEN RETURN FALSE END;
794. 
795.     (* scan the frame stack looking for the first active handler *)
796.     i := tos - 1;
797.     LOOP
798.       IF (i < 0) THEN RETURN FALSE END;
799.       WITH z = stack[i] DO
800.         CASE z.kind OF
801.         | Kind.zTRYELSE     => EXIT;
802.         | Kind.zFINALLYPROC => (* ignore the runtime does it *)
803.         | Kind.zFINALLY     => EXIT;
804.         | Kind.zLOCK        => (* ignore *)
805.         | Kind.zEXIT        => (* ignore *)
806.         | Kind.zTRY         => EXIT;
807.         | Kind.zRAISES      => (* ignore *)
808.         | Kind.zPROC        => RETURN FALSE;  (* didn't find any handlers *)
809.         END;
810.       END;
811.       DEC (i);
812.     END;
813. 
814.     handler_body := stack[i].stopBody;
815.     handler := stack[i].stop;
816.     info := stack[i].info;
817.     RETURN TRUE;
818.   END NextHandler;
819. 
820. PROCEDURE Excepts() : ESet.EList =
821.   VAR i: INTEGER; e,t,ret : ESet.EList := NIL;
822.   BEGIN
823.     IF NOT Target.Has_stack_walker THEN RETURN NIL END;
824. 
825.     (* scan the frame stack getting each frames list of handled exceptions *)
826.     i := tos - 1;
827.     WHILE (i >= 0) DO
828.       e := ESet.ListE(stack[i].e_set);
829.       IF e # NIL THEN
830.         t := e;

69.     here, f: RTStack.Frame;
70.     scan : BOOLEAN;
71.   BEGIN

74.       PrintStack (a.exception.uid);

78.     RTStack.PreviousFrame (here, f); (* skip self *)

93.           RAISE OUCH;
94.         END;
95.       END;
96. 
97.       (* try the previous frame *)
98.       RTStack.PreviousFrame (f, f);
99.     END;
100.   END ResumeRaise;

<sub>⏱️ 2640m 23s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

Now I have the complete picture. Here's the definitive architectural analysis.

## The Core Problem with Path 1

The crux is a structural mismatch between M3 and C++:

**In LLVM/GCC IR** (what m3cc targets): `invoke proc → normal_successor, unwind_landing_pad` — the landing pad is a *separate entity* that can be inside an *outer* protected region. Re-throwing from a landing pad is naturally caught by the outer protected region.

**In C++**: `try { } catch { }` — the catch block is *outside* the associated try block. Re-throwing from inside a catch goes to the *caller*, not to an enclosing same-function try block.

**In m3front's TryStmt.Compile1** today, the landing pad and handler code are *inside* `Start_try`/`End_try`. If we naively map `Start_try → try {` and `End_try → } catch { }`, a re-throw from an unmatched inner handler re-enters the inner catch → infinite loop.

## The Correct Architecture for Path 1

The fix is elegant: **move `End_try()` before the landing pad** (requires a one-line change to TryStmt.m3), then M3C.m3 can track the handler label from `invoke_direct` calls and emit the right catch clause at `end_try`. The landing pad then sits *outside* the inner try but *inside* any outer try — exactly the nesting LLVM IR achieves:

```c
/* OUTER start_try: */ try {
  /* INNER start_try: */ try {
    P1();                          /* invoke_direct: plain call, no wrapper */
    goto L_body_done;
  } /* INNER end_try (moved early): */ catch (_M3Exc& _e) {
    _m3_caught = _e.act;
    goto L_inner;                  /* jump INTO outer try — valid in C++ */
  }
  /* landing pad is now OUTSIDE inner try, INSIDE outer try: */
  L_inner:;                        /* Set_label(l+1) */
  /* landing_pad: push _m3_caught */
  /* store_addr(info): info = _m3_caught */
  /* uid check: if E2, no match → throw _M3Exc{info}; → caught by outer catch ✓ */
  L_body_done:;
  P2();                            /* invoke_direct: plain call inside outer try */
  goto L_outer_body_done;
  L_outer:;                        /* outer landing pad, OUTSIDE outer try */
  /* outer uid check */
  L_outer_body_done:;
} /* OUTER end_try (moved early): */ catch (_M3Exc& _e) {
  _m3_caught = _e.act;
  goto L_outer;
}
```

## Complete Change Set

| File | Change | Complexity |
|------|--------|------------|
| `m3front/src/stmts/TryStmt.m3` | Move `CG.End_try()` before `CG.Set_label(l+1)` in Compile1; fix `CompileHandler1` to always generate UID checks (not skip for `last=TRUE`) with backstop call on no-match | Small |
| `m3front/src/stmts/TryFinStmt.m3` | Same restructure for TRY/FINALLY | Small |
| `m3back/src/M3C.m3` | (1) Add `struct _M3Exc { void* act; }` and `__thread void* _m3_caught` to preamble; (2) `start_try` → push try-context, emit `try {`; (3) `invoke_direct` → update context handler label, emit plain call; (4) `end_try` → pop context, emit `} catch (_M3Exc& _e) { _m3_caught = _e.act; goto L{handler}; }`; (5) `landing_pad` → push `CTextToExpr("_m3_caught")` | Medium |
| `m3core/runtime/ARM64_DARWIN/RTStackC.c` | Add `extern "C" void RTStack__ThrowM3Exc(void* act) { throw _M3Exc{act}; }` | Trivial |
| `m3core/runtime/common/RTHooks.m3` | `Raise` calls `RTStack__ThrowM3Exc(ADR(a))` instead of `RTException.Raise(a)` | Small |
| `m3core/runtime/m3makefile` | Enable `M3_USE_STACK_WALKER` for ARM64_DARWIN | Done |
| `~/cm3/bin/config/ARM64_DARWIN` | Enable `M3_USE_STACK_WALKER = TRUE` | Done |

Then: full three-stage bootstrap.

## Key Subtleties

1. **`_m3_caught` scoping**: Declared thread-local (not per-try), safe because the sequence `catch → goto landing_pad → store_addr(info)` is atomic with respect to other exceptions (no M3 calls in between).

2. **`last=TRUE` handler**: Currently m3front skips UID check for the last handler (assuming RTExStack pre-filtered). With catch-all, this is wrong. `CompileHandler1` needs to always check, and on no-match with `another=FALSE`, call `RTException.InvokeBackstop`.

3. **`invoke_direct` as plain call**: Since the surrounding `try { }` from `start_try` catches everything from the whole region, per-call wrapping is not needed. `invoke_direct` just emits the same code as `call_direct`, but also updates the try context's handler label (used later by `end_try`).

4. **Handler code calls**: When m3front compiles handler bodies, `Marker.Pop()` has already been called for the inner try — so calls inside handler bodies use the *outer* handler label via `Marker.NextHandler`. These become plain calls inside the outer `try { }` block, correctly covered by the outer catch.

5. **m3cc compatibility**: Moving `End_try()` before the landing pad may need to be guarded by a backend-specific flag, or verified harmless for m3cc (since LLVM IR landing pads are already outside their invoke's protected region).

---

Want to proceed with implementation? The natural order is: (1) m3back/M3C.m3 changes, (2) RTStackC.c/RTHooks.m3 changes, (3) m3front/TryStmt.m3 changes, (4) rebuild everything, (5) bootstrap.

382. PROCEDURE CompileHandler1 (h: Handler;  info: CG.Var;
383.                          resume: CG.Label;  last: BOOLEAN): Stmt.Outcomes =
384.   VAR
385.     e: Except;
386.     oc: Stmt.Outcomes;
387.     zz: Scope.T;
388.     top: CG.Label;
389.     need_top := FALSE;
390.     t_info: Type.Info;
391.   BEGIN
392.     top := CG.Next_label (2);
393. 
394.     CG.Gen_location (h.origin);
395. 
396.     IF (NOT last) THEN
397.       (* check for a match *)
398.       e := h.tags;
399.       <*ASSERT e # NIL*>
400.       WHILE (e # NIL) DO
401.         CG.Load_addr (info, M3RT.EA_exception, Target.Address.align);
402.         CG.Boost_addr_alignment (Target.Address.align);
403.         CG.Load_indirect (CG.Type.Addr, 0, Target.Address.size);
404.         CG.Boost_addr_alignment (Target.Integer.align);
405.         CG.Load_indirect (Target.Integer.cg_type, 0, Target.Integer.size);
406.         CG.Load_intt (Exceptionz.UID (e.obj));
407.         e := e.next;
408.         IF (e # NIL) THEN
409.           CG.If_compare (Target.Integer.cg_type, CG.Cmp.EQ, top, CG.Maybe);
410.           need_top := TRUE;
411.         ELSE
412.           CG.If_compare (Target.Integer.cg_type, CG.Cmp.NE, top+1, CG.Maybe);
413.         END;
414.       END;
415.     END;
416. 
417.     IF (need_top) THEN CG.Set_label (top) END;
418. 
419.     IF (h.scope # NIL) THEN
420.       zz := Scope.Push (h.scope);
421.         Scope.Enter (h.scope);
422.         Scope.InitValues (h.scope);
423.         Variable.LoadLValue (h.var);
424.         EVAL Type.CheckInfo (h.type, t_info);
425.         IF Exceptionz.ArgByReference (h.type) THEN
426.           CG.Load_addr (info, M3RT.EA_exception, Target.Address.align);
427.           CG.Boost_addr_alignment (Target.Address.align);
428.           CG.Load_indirect (CG.Type.Addr, M3RT.EA_arg, Target.Address.size);
429.           CG.Boost_addr_alignment (t_info.alignment);
430.           CG.Copy (t_info.size, overlap := FALSE);
431.         ELSE
432.           CG.Load_addr (info, M3RT.EA_exception, Target.Address.align);
433.           CG.Boost_addr_alignment (Target.Address.align);
434.           CG.Load_indirect (CG.Type.Addr, M3RT.EA_arg, Target.Address.size);
435.           CG.Loophole (CG.Type.Addr, t_info.stk_type);
436.           CG.Store_indirect (t_info.stk_type, 0, t_info.size);
437.         END;
438.         Variable.ScheduleTrace (h.var);
439.         oc := Stmt.Compile (h.body);
440.         IF (Stmt.Outcome.FallThrough IN oc) THEN CG.Jump (resume) END;
441.         (* for the debugger's sake, this Jump should be inside the scope *)
442.         Scope.Exit (h.scope);
443.       Scope.Pop (zz);
444.     ELSE
445.       oc := Stmt.Compile (h.body);
446.       IF (Stmt.Outcome.FallThrough IN oc) THEN CG.Jump (resume) END;
447.     END;
448. 
449.     CG.Set_label (top+1);
450.     RETURN oc;
451.   END CompileHandler1;

131. /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
132. /* PROCEDURE CurrentFrame (VAR(*OUT*) f: Frame)
133.  * Returns the frame that corresponds to the caller of this function. */
134. 
135. void RTStack__CurFrame (Frame *f)
136. {
137.   unw_context_t *uc;
138.   unw_cursor_t *cursor;
139.   unw_word_t ip, sp = 0;
140. 
141.   /* Allocate from the M3 heap so the cursor lifetime is managed there. */
142.   uc     = (unw_context_t *) RTException__AllocBuf(sizeof(unw_context_t));
143.   cursor = (unw_cursor_t *)  RTException__AllocBuf(sizeof(unw_cursor_t));
144. 
145.   f->lock = FrameLock;
146.   unw_getcontext(uc);
147.   unw_init_local(cursor, uc);
148.   unw_get_reg(cursor, UNW_REG_IP, &ip);
149.   unw_get_reg(cursor, UNW_REG_SP, &sp);
150. 
151.   f->cursor = cursor;
152.   f->pc     = ip;
153.   f->sp     = sp;
154.   RTStack__GetProcInfo(f);
155. 
156.   if (f->lock != FrameLock) abort();
157. }
158. 
159. /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
160. /* PROCEDURE PreviousFrame (READONLY callee: Frame;  VAR(*OUT*) caller: Frame)
161.    Return the stack frame that called "callee".  Returns with pc = NIL if
162.    "callee" is the first frame on the stack or its predecessor is ill-formed.
163.    */
164. 
165. void RTStack__PrevFrame (Frame* callee, Frame* caller)
166. {
167.   unw_word_t ip, sp = 0;
168.   int res;
169. 
170.   if (!callee->cursor)           abort();
171.   if (callee->lock != FrameLock) abort();
172. 
173.   *caller = *callee;
174. 
175.   res = unw_step(caller->cursor);
176.   if (res > 0) {
177.     unw_get_reg(caller->cursor, UNW_REG_IP, &ip);
178.     unw_get_reg(caller->cursor, UNW_REG_SP, &sp);
179. 
180.     caller->pc = ip;
181.     caller->sp = sp;
182.     RTStack__GetProcInfo(caller);
183.   } else {
184.     caller->pc = 0;
185.     caller->sp = 0;
186.   }
187. 
188.   if (caller->lock != FrameLock) abort();
189. }
190. 
191. /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
192. /* PROCEDURE Unwind (READONLY f: Frame);
193.    Restore the machine state back to the frame "f".  All callee-saved
194.    registers must be restored to the state they were in when frame "f"
195.    made its last call. */
196. 
197. void RTStack__Unwind (Frame *target)
198. {
199.   int res;
200. 
201.   if (!target->cursor)           abort();
202.   if (target->lock != FrameLock) abort();
203. 
204.   /* Set IP to the landing pad computed by RTEHScan.ScanEHTable. */
205.   unw_set_reg(target->cursor, UNW_REG_IP, target->landingPad);
206. 
207.   /* Pass the exception object pointer in EH data register 0. */
208.   unw_set_reg(target->cursor,
209.               __builtin_eh_return_data_regno(EHObjRegNo),
210.               target->exceptionRef);
211. 
212.   /* Pass the tTypeIndex (exception selector) in EH data register 1. */
213.   unw_set_reg(target->cursor,
214.               __builtin_eh_return_data_regno(EHTypeRegNo),
215.               target->tTypeIndex);
216. 
217.   res = unw_resume(target->cursor);
218.   /* unw_resume only returns on error. */
219.   if (res < 0) {
220.     printf("RTStack__Unwind - unw_resume error\n");
221.     abort();
222.   }
223. }
224. 
225. #ifdef __cplusplus
226. } /* extern "C" */
227. #endif
228.
```

123. PROCEDURE Compile1 (p: P): Stmt.Outcomes =
124.   VAR
125.     oc, xc, o: Stmt.Outcomes;
126.     lab, xx: CG.Label;
127.     info: CG.Var;
128.     proc: Procedure.T;
129.     returnSeen, exitSeen : BOOLEAN;
130.     catches := ARRAY[0..0] OF CG.TypeUID{0};
131.   BEGIN
132.     (* declare and initialize the info record *)
133.     info := CG.Declare_local (M3ID.NoID, Target.Address.size, Target.Address.align,
134.                               CG.Type.Addr, 0, in_memory := TRUE,
135.                               up_level := FALSE, f := CG.Never);
136.     CG.Load_nil ();
137.     CG.Store_addr (info, M3RT.EA_exception);
138. 
139.     (* compile the body *)
140.     lab := CG.Next_label (4);
141.     CG.Set_label (lab, barrier := TRUE);
142.     CG.Start_try ();
143. 
144.     Marker.PushFinally (lab, lab+1, lab+2, info);
145.     Marker.SaveFrame ();
146.       oc := Stmt.Compile (p.body);
147.     Marker.PopFinally (returnSeen, exitSeen);
148. 
149.     CG.Jump (lab+2);
150.     CG.Set_label (lab+1);
151.     CG.Landing_pad(lab+1, catches);
152.     CG.Store_addr (info);
153.     CG.Set_label (lab+2);
154. 
155.     (* set the "Compiler.ThisException()" globals *)
156.     TryStmt.PushHandler (info, 0, direct := FALSE);
157. 
158.     (* compile the handler *)
159.     Scanner.offset := p.forigin;
160.     CG.Gen_location (p.forigin);
161.       xc := Stmt.Compile (p.finally);
162. 
163.     IF (Outcome.FallThrough IN xc) THEN
164.       (* exceptional outcome? *)
165.       CG.Load_addr (info, M3RT.EA_exception, Target.Address.align);
166.       CG.Load_nil ();
167.       CG.If_compare (CG.Type.Addr, CG.Cmp.EQ, lab+3, CG.Always);
168. 
169.       IF (exitSeen) THEN
170.         xx := CG.Next_label ();
171.         CG.Load_addr (info, M3RT.EA_exception, Target.Address.align);
172.         CG.Loophole (CG.Type.Addr, Target.Integer.cg_type );
173. 
174.         CG.Load_intt (Marker.Exit_exception);
175.         CG.If_compare (Target.Integer.cg_type, CG.Cmp.NE, xx, CG.Always);
176.         Marker.EmitExit ();
177.         CG.Set_label (xx);
178.       END;
179. 
180.       IF (returnSeen) THEN
181.         xx := CG.Next_label ();
182.         CG.Load_addr (info, M3RT.EA_exception, Target.Address.align);
183.         CG.Loophole (CG.Type.Addr, Target.Integer.cg_type );
184. 
185.         CG.Load_intt (Marker.Return_exception);
186.         CG.If_compare (Target.Integer.cg_type, CG.Cmp.NE, xx, CG.Always);
187.         Marker.EmitReturn (NIL, fromFinally := TRUE);
188.         CG.Set_label (xx);
189.       END;
190. 
191.       (* resume the exception *)
192.       proc := RunTyme.LookUpProc (RunTyme.Hook.ResumeRaiseEx);
193.       Procedure.StartCall (proc);
194.       CG.Load_addr (info, 0, Target.Address.align);
195.       CG.Pop_param (CG.Type.Addr);
196.       Procedure.EmitCall (proc);
197.       CG.Set_label (lab+3, barrier := TRUE);
198.     END;
199. 
200.     (* restore the "Compiler.ThisException()" globals *)
201.     TryStmt.PopHandler ();
202.     CG.End_try ();
203. 
204.     o := Stmt.Outcomes {};
205.     IF Outcome.FallThrough IN xc THEN o := oc END;
206.     IF Outcome.Exits IN xc   THEN o := o + Stmt.Outcomes {Outcome.Exits} END;
207.     IF Outcome.Returns IN xc THEN o := o + Stmt.Outcomes {Outcome.Returns} END;
208.     RETURN o;
209.   END Compile1;
210.

212.   VAR
213.     oc, xc, o: Stmt.Outcomes;
214.     lab: CG.Label;
215.     frame: CG.Var;

33. PROCEDURE Raise (VAR act: RaiseActivation) RAISES ANY =
34.   VAR
35.     here, f: RTStack.Frame;
36.     excRef : REF RaiseActivation;
37.     scan : BOOLEAN;
38.   BEGIN
39.     IF DEBUG THEN
40.       PutExcept ("RAISE", act);
41.       PrintStack (act.exception.uid);
42.     END;
43. 
44.     RTStack.CurrentFrame (here);
45.     RTStack.PreviousFrame (here, f); (* skip self *)
46.     LOOP
47.       IF (f.pc = NIL) THEN
48.         (* we're at the end of the stack (or we got lost along the way!) *)
49.         InvokeBackstop (act, raises := FALSE);
50.       END;

52.       IF f.lsda # NIL THEN
53.         (* scan the dwarf eh scopes found by the unwinder *)
54.         scan := RTEHScan.ScanEHTable(f, act.exception.uid);
55.         IF scan THEN
56.           excRef := NEW(REF RaiseActivation);
57.           excRef^ := act;
58.           ResumeRaise (excRef^)
59.         END;
60.       END;
61. 
62.       (* try the previous frame *)
63.       RTStack.PreviousFrame (f, f);
64.     END; (* loop *)
65.   END Raise;
66. 
67. PROCEDURE ResumeRaise (VAR a: RaiseActivation) RAISES ANY =
68.   VAR
69.     here, f: RTStack.Frame;
70.     scan : BOOLEAN;
71.   BEGIN
72.     IF DEBUG THEN
73.       PutExcept ("RERAISE", a);
74.       PrintStack (a.exception.uid);
75.     END;
76. 
77.     RTStack.CurrentFrame (here);
78.     RTStack.PreviousFrame (here, f); (* skip self *)
79.     LOOP
80.       IF (f.pc = NIL) THEN
81.         (* we're at the end of the stack (most likely unhandled exception) *)
82.         InvokeBackstop (a, raises := FALSE);
83.       END;
84. 
85.       IF f.lsda # NIL THEN
86.         (* scan the dwarf eh scopes found by the unwinder *)
87.         scan := RTEHScan.ScanEHTable(f, a.exception.uid);
88.         IF scan THEN
89.           (* landingpad set in scan *)
90.           f.excRef := ADR(a);
91.           RTStack.Unwind (f);
92.           RTError.MsgPC (LOOPHOLE (f.pc, INTEGER), "Unwind returned!");
93.           RAISE OUCH;
94.         END;
95.       END;
96. 
97.       (* try the previous frame *)
98.       RTStack.PreviousFrame (f, f);
99.     END;
100.   END ResumeRaise;

7917.    returns a value of type type. *)
7918. VAR proc := NARROW(p, Proc_t);
7919. BEGIN
7920.     IF debug_verbose THEN

7922.     ELSIF debug THEN
7923.       self.comment("call_direct");
7924.     END;
7925.

7927.

7929.         self.params.addhi(get_static_link(self, proc));
7930.     END;
7931. 
7932.     call_helper(self, type, NameT(proc.name));
7933. END call_direct;
7934.

7937.    procedure returns a value of type type. *)

7939.     static_link := self.static_link;
7940.     param_types: TEXT := NIL;
7941. BEGIN
7942.     IF debug_verbose THEN

7944.     ELSIF debug THEN

7946.     END;
7947. 
7948.     pop(self);
7949. 
7950.     <* ASSERT self.in_proc_call *>
7951.

7953.         self.params.addhi(static_link);
7954.         free_temp(self, static_link.var);
7955.         self.static_link := NIL;
7956.     END;
7957.

6365. VAR min := self.labels_min;
6366. BEGIN
6367.     self.comment("set_label");
6368.     IF self.labels # NIL AND label >= self.labels_min AND label <= self.labels_max AND self.labels[label - min] THEN

300. PROCEDURE Compile1 (p: P): Stmt.Outcomes =
301.   VAR
302.     oc: Stmt.Outcomes;
303.     l, next_handler, handler_body: CG.Label;
304.     info, next_info: CG.Var;
305.     h: Handler;
306.     another: BOOLEAN;
307.     catches : Caught;
308.   BEGIN
309.     (* declare and initialize the info record *)
310. 
311.     info := CG.Declare_local (M3ID.NoID, Target.Address.size,
312.                               Target.Address.align, CG.Type.Addr, 0,
313.                               in_memory := TRUE, up_level := FALSE,
314.                               f := CG.Never);
315. 
316.     CG.Load_nil ();
317.     CG.Store_addr (info, M3RT.EA_exception);
318. 
319.     (* compile the body *)
320.     l := CG.Next_label (4);
321.     CG.Set_label (l, barrier := TRUE);
322.     CG.Start_try ();
323.     IF (p.hasElse)
324.       THEN Marker.PushTryElse (l, l+1, l+2, info);
325.       ELSE Marker.PushTry (l, l+1, l+2, info, p.handled);
326.     END;
327.     Marker.SaveFrame ();
328.       oc := Stmt.Compile (p.body);
329.     Marker.Pop ();
330. 
331.     IF (Stmt.Outcome.FallThrough IN oc) THEN
332.       CG.Jump (l+3);
333.     END;
334. 
335.     IF (p.hasElse) THEN
336.       (* EXITs and RETURNs from the body are caught by the ELSE clause *)
337.       oc := oc - Stmt.Outcomes {Stmt.Outcome.Returns, Stmt.Outcome.Exits};
338.     END;
339. 
340.     (* check for enclosing handlers *)
341.     another := Marker.NextHandler (next_handler, handler_body, next_info);
342. 
343.     (* set the "Compiler.ThisException()" globals *)
344.     PushHandler (info, 0, direct := FALSE);
345. 
346.     CG.Set_label (l+1, barrier := TRUE);
347.     Scanner.offset := p.h_origin;
348.     CG.Gen_location (p.h_origin);
349. 
350.     (* generate the landing pad *)
351.     catches := Handled(p);
352.     CG.Landing_pad (l+1, catches^);
353.     CG.Store_addr (info);
354. 
355.     (* set the body label *)
356.     CG.Set_label (l+2);
357. 
358.     (* compile each of the handlers *)
359.     h := p.handles;
360.     WHILE (h # NIL) DO
361.       oc := oc + CompileHandler1 (h, info, l+3,
362.                        (NOT p.hasElse) AND (h.next = NIL) AND (NOT another));
363.       h := h.next;
364.     END;
365. 
366.     IF (p.hasElse) THEN
367.       oc := oc + Stmt.Compile (p.elseBody);
368.     ELSIF another THEN
369.       (* we didn't eat this exception => mark and invoke the next handler *)
370.       CG.Load_addr (info, 0, Target.Address.align);
371.       CG.Store_addr (next_info);
372.       CG.Jump (handler_body);
373.     END;
374. 
375.     (* restore the "Compiler.ThisException()" globals *)
376.     PopHandler ();
377.     CG.End_try ();
378.     CG.Set_label (l+3);
379.     RETURN oc;
380.   END Compile1;

387. 
388. PROCEDURE CompileHandler1 (h: Handler;  info: CG.Var;
389.                          resume: CG.Label;  last: BOOLEAN): Stmt.Outcomes =
390.   VAR
391.     e: Except;
392.     oc: Stmt.Outcomes;
393.     zz: Scope.T;
394.     top: CG.Label;
395.     need_top := FALSE;
396.     t_info: Type.Info;
397.   BEGIN
398.     top := CG.Next_label (2);
399. 
400.     CG.Gen_location (h.origin);
401. 
402.     IF (NOT last) THEN
403.       (* check for a match *)
404.       e := h.tags;
405.       <*ASSERT e # NIL*>
406.       WHILE (e # NIL) DO
407.         CG.Load_addr (info, M3RT.EA_exception, Target.Address.align);
408.         CG.Boost_addr_alignment (Target.Address.align);
409.         CG.Load_indirect (CG.Type.Addr, 0, Target.Address.size);
410.         CG.Boost_addr_alignment (Target.Integer.align);
411.         CG.Load_indirect (Target.Integer.cg_type, 0, Target.Integer.size);
412.         CG.Load_intt (Exceptionz.UID (e.obj));
413.         e := e.next;
414.         IF (e # NIL) THEN
415.           CG.If_compare (Target.Integer.cg_type, CG.Cmp.EQ, top, CG.Maybe);
416.           need_top := TRUE;
417.         ELSE
418.           CG.If_compare (Target.Integer.cg_type, CG.Cmp.NE, top+1, CG.Maybe);
419.         END;
420.       END;
421.     END;
422. 
423.     IF (need_top) THEN CG.Set_label (top) END;
424. 
425.     IF (h.scope # NIL) THEN
426.       zz := Scope.Push (h.scope);
427.         Scope.Enter (h.scope);
428.         Scope.InitValues (h.scope);
429.         Variable.LoadLValue (h.var);
430.         EVAL Type.CheckInfo (h.type, t_info);
431.         IF Exceptionz.ArgByReference (h.type) THEN
432.           CG.Load_addr (info, M3RT.EA_exception, Target.Address.align);
433.           CG.Boost_addr_alignment (Target.Address.align);
434.           CG.Load_indirect (CG.Type.Addr, M3RT.EA_arg, Target.Address.size);
435.           CG.Boost_addr_alignment (t_info.alignment);
436.           CG.Copy (t_info.size, overlap := FALSE);
437.         ELSE
438.           CG.Load_addr (info, M3RT.EA_exception, Target.Address.align);
439.           CG.Boost_addr_alignment (Target.Address.align);
440.           CG.Load_indirect (CG.Type.Addr, M3RT.EA_arg, Target.Address.size);
441.           CG.Loophole (CG.Type.Addr, t_info.stk_type);
442.           CG.Store_indirect (t_info.stk_type, 0, t_info.size);
443.         END;
444.         Variable.ScheduleTrace (h.var);
445.         oc := Stmt.Compile (h.body);
446.         IF (Stmt.Outcome.FallThrough IN oc) THEN CG.Jump (resume) END;
447.         (* for the debugger's sake, this Jump should be inside the scope *)
448.         Scope.Exit (h.scope);
449.       Scope.Pop (zz);
450.     ELSE
451.       oc := Stmt.Compile (h.body);
452.       IF (Stmt.Outcome.FallThrough IN oc) THEN CG.Jump (resume) END;
453.     END;
454. 
455.     CG.Set_label (top+1);
```

459. PROCEDURE Compile2 (p: P): Stmt.Outcomes =
460.   VAR
461.     oc: Stmt.Outcomes;
462.     h: Handler;
463.     l: CG.Label;
464.     frame, eset: CG.Var;
465.     eoffset: INTEGER;
466.   BEGIN
467.     l := CG.Next_label (3);
468.     CG.Set_label (l, barrier := TRUE);
469. 
470.     (* declare and initialize the info record *)
471.     frame := CG.Declare_local (M3ID.NoID, M3RT.EF1_SIZE, Target.Address.align,
472.                                CG.Type.Struct, 0, in_memory := TRUE,
473.                                up_level := FALSE, f := CG.Never);
474. 
475.     (**********************************************
476.     (* mark the frame: no exception happened yet *)
477.     CG.Load_nil ();
478.     CG.Store_addr (frame, M3RT.EF1_exception);
479.     ***********************************************)
480. 
481.     IF (p.hasElse) THEN
482.       Marker.PushTryElse (l, l+1, 0, frame);
483.       Marker.PushFrame (frame, M3RT.HandlerClass.ExceptElse);
484.     ELSE
485.       Marker.PushTry (l, l+1, 0, frame, p.handled);
486.       ESet.GetAddress (p.handled, eset, eoffset);
487.       CG.Load_addr_of (eset, eoffset, Target.Integer.align);
488.       CG.Store_addr (frame, M3RT.EF1_handles);
489.       Marker.PushFrame (frame, M3RT.HandlerClass.Except);
490.     END;
491. 
492.     (* capture the machine state *)
493.     Marker.CaptureState (frame, Jmpbufs.CompileTryGetJmpbuf (p.jmpbufs), l+1);
494. 
495.     (* compile the body *)
496.     oc := Stmt.Compile (p.body);
497.     Marker.Pop ();
498.     IF (Stmt.Outcome.FallThrough IN oc) THEN
499.       Marker.PopFrame (frame);
500.       CG.Jump (l+2);
501.     END;
502. 
503.     IF (p.hasElse) THEN
504.       (* EXITs and RETURNs from the body are caught by the ELSE clause *)
505.       oc := oc - Stmt.Outcomes {Stmt.Outcome.Returns, Stmt.Outcome.Exits};
506.     END;
507. 
508.     (* set the "Compiler.ThisException()" globals *)
509.     PushHandler (frame, M3RT.EF1_info, direct := TRUE);
510. 
511.     (* compile each of the handlers *)
512.     CG.Set_label (l+1, barrier := TRUE);
513.     Scanner.offset := p.h_origin;
514.     CG.Gen_location (p.h_origin);
515.     h := p.handles;
516.     WHILE (h # NIL) DO
517.       oc := oc + CompileHandler2 (h, frame, l+2,
518.                                   (NOT p.hasElse) AND (h.next = NIL));
519.       h := h.next;
520.     END;
521. 
522.     IF (p.hasElse) THEN
523.       oc := oc + Stmt.Compile (p.elseBody);
524.     END;
525. 
526.     (* restore the "Compiler.ThisException()" globals *)
527.     PopHandler ();
528. 
529.     CG.Set_label (l+2);
530. 
531.     RETURN oc;
532.   END Compile2;
533. 
534. PROCEDURE CompileHandler2 (h: Handler;  frame: CG.Var;
535.                          resume: CG.Label;  last: BOOLEAN): Stmt.Outcomes =
536.   VAR
537.     e: Except;
538.     oc: Stmt.Outcomes;
539.     zz: Scope.T;
540.     top: CG.Label;
541.     need_top := FALSE;
542.     t_info: Type.Info;
543.   BEGIN
544.     top := CG.Next_label (2);
545. 
546.     CG.Gen_location (h.origin);
547. 
548.     IF (NOT last) THEN
549.       (* check for a match *)
550.       e := h.tags;
551.       <*ASSERT e # NIL*>
552.       WHILE (e # NIL) DO
553.         CG.Load_addr
554.           (frame, M3RT.EF1_info + M3RT.EA_exception, Target.Address.align);

557.         CG.Load_intt (Exceptionz.UID (e.obj));  (** Value.Load (e.obj);  **)
558.         e := e.next;
559.         IF (e # NIL)
560.           THEN CG.If_compare (Target.Integer.cg_type, CG.Cmp.EQ, top, CG.Maybe);  need_top := TRUE;

127. PROCEDURE ResumeRaise (VAR a: RT0.RaiseActivation) RAISES ANY =
128.   VAR
129.     f := LOOPHOLE(RTThread.GetCurrentHandlers(), Frame);
130.     ex: ExceptionList;
131.   BEGIN
132.     IF DEBUG THEN
133.       PutExcept ("RERAISE", a);
134.       RTIO.Flush ();
135.       DumpStack ();
136.     END;
137. 
138.     LOOP
139.       IF (f = NIL) THEN  BadStack ();  END;
140. 
141.       CASE f.class OF
142.       | ORD (ScopeKind.ExceptElse),
143.         ORD (ScopeKind.Finally) =>
144.           InvokeHandler (f, a);
145.       | ORD (ScopeKind.Except) =>
146.           ex := LOOPHOLE (f, PF1).handles;
147.           WHILE (ex^ # 0) DO
148.             IF (ex^ = a.exception.uid) THEN InvokeHandler (f, a) END;
149.             INC (ex, ADRSIZE (ex^));
150.           END;
151.       | ORD (ScopeKind.FinallyProc) =>
152.           InvokeFinallyHandler (f, a);
153.       | ORD (ScopeKind.Lock) =>
154.           ReleaseLock (f);
155.       | ORD (ScopeKind.Raises), ORD (ScopeKind.RaisesNone) =>
156.           (* already checked during the first pass *)
157.       ELSE
158.           BadStack ();
159.       END;
160. 
161.       RTThread.SetCurrentHandlers (f.next); (* cut to the new handler *)
162.       f := f.next;                         (* try the previous frame *)
163.     END;
164.   END ResumeRaise;
165. 
166. PROCEDURE InvokeHandler (f: Frame;  READONLY a: RT0.RaiseActivation) RAISES ANY =
167.   VAR p := LOOPHOLE (f, PF1);
168.   BEGIN
169.     IF DEBUG THEN
170.       PutExcept ("INVOKE HANDLER", a);

36.     excRef : REF RaiseActivation;

115. PROCEDURE PrintStack (uid : INTEGER) =
116.   CONST CallInstructionSize = 8; (* was 4 - should be gotten from Target *)
117.   VAR
118.     here, f: RTStack.Frame;
119.     name: RTProcedureSRC.Name;
120.     scan : BOOLEAN;
121.   BEGIN
122.     RTOS.LockHeap (); (* disable thread switching... (you wish!) *)
123. 
124.     RTIO.PutText ("------------------------- STACK DUMP ---------------------------\n");
125.     RTIO.PutText ("----PC----      ----SP----      --------Procedure--------\n");
126. 
127.     RTStack.CurrentFrame (here);
128.     RTStack.PreviousFrame (here, f); (* skip self *)
129. 
130.     WHILE (f.pc # NIL) DO
131. 
132.       IF f.lsda # NIL THEN
133.         IF uid # 0 THEN
134.           (* scan the dwarf eh scopes found by the unwinder *)
135.           scan := RTEHScan.ScanEHTable(f, uid);
136.           IF scan THEN
137.             (* print the exception stuff. Fixme. Would have to modify
138.                ScanEHTable to take a parameter to dump its debug info. *)
139.           END;
140.         END;
141.       END;
142. 
143.       (* print the procedure's frame *)
144.       (* This is only approximate. The pc will be the one after the call that
145.          results in the chain leading to crash (which prints this trace).
146.          And call instructions can vary in size. *)
147.       RTIO.PutAddr (f.pc - CallInstructionSize, 10);
148.       RTIO.PutText ("  ");
149.       RTIO.PutAddr (f.sp, 10);
150. 
151.       name := RTStack.ProcName (f);
152.       RTIO.PutText ("  [");
153.       IF (name # NIL)
154.         (* not sure why they were checking for "static procedure" probably
155.            an artifact of an old architecture/os *)
156.         (* AND Cstring.memcmp (name, ADR(NoName), NUMBER(NoName)) # 0 *) THEN
157.         RTIO.PutString (name);
158.       END;
159.       RTIO.PutText ("]\n");
160. 
161.       (* try the previous frame *)
162.       RTStack.PreviousFrame (f, f);
163.     END;
164. 
165.     RTIO.PutText ("----------------------------------------------------------------\n");
166.     RTIO.Flush ();
167. 
168.     RTOS.UnlockHeap (); (* re-enable thread switching *)
169.   END PrintStack;

190.       RTIO.PutText ("  arg=");        RTIO.PutAddr (a.un_arg);

388. PROCEDURE CompileHandler1 (h: Handler;  info: CG.Var;
389.                          resume: CG.Label;  last: BOOLEAN): Stmt.Outcomes =
390.   VAR
391.     e: Except;
392.     oc: Stmt.Outcomes;
393.     zz: Scope.T;
394.     top: CG.Label;
395.     need_top := FALSE;
396.     t_info: Type.Info;
397.   BEGIN
398.     top := CG.Next_label (2);
399. 
400.     CG.Gen_location (h.origin);
401. 
402.     IF (NOT last) THEN
403.       (* check for a match *)
404.       e := h.tags;
405.       <*ASSERT e # NIL*>
406.       WHILE (e # NIL) DO
407.         CG.Load_addr (info, M3RT.EA_exception, Target.Address.align);
408.         CG.Boost_addr_alignment (Target.Address.align);
409.         CG.Load_indirect (CG.Type.Addr, 0, Target.Address.size);
410.         CG.Boost_addr_alignment (Target.Integer.align);
411.         CG.Load_indirect (Target.Integer.cg_type, 0, Target.Integer.size);
412.         CG.Load_intt (Exceptionz.UID (e.obj));
413.         e := e.next;
414.         IF (e # NIL) THEN
415.           CG.If_compare (Target.Integer.cg_type, CG.Cmp.EQ, top, CG.Maybe);
416.           need_top := TRUE;
417.         ELSE
418.           CG.If_compare (Target.Integer.cg_type, CG.Cmp.NE, top+1, CG.Maybe);
419.         END;
420.       END;
421.     END;
422. 
423.     IF (need_top) THEN CG.Set_label (top) END;
424. 
425.     IF (h.scope # NIL) THEN
426.       zz := Scope.Push (h.scope);
427.         Scope.Enter (h.scope);
428.         Scope.InitValues (h.scope);
429.         Variable.LoadLValue (h.var);
430.         EVAL Type.CheckInfo (h.type, t_info);
431.         IF Exceptionz.ArgByReference (h.type) THEN
432.           CG.Load_addr (info, M3RT.EA_exception, Target.Address.align);
433.           CG.Boost_addr_alignment (Target.Address.align);
434.           CG.Load_indirect (CG.Type.Addr, M3RT.EA_arg, Target.Address.size);
435.           CG.Boost_addr_alignment (t_info.alignment);
436.           CG.Copy (t_info.size, overlap := FALSE);
437.         ELSE
438.           CG.Load_addr (info, M3RT.EA_exception, Target.Address.align);
439.           CG.Boost_addr_alignment (Target.Address.align);
440.           CG.Load_indirect (CG.Type.Addr, M3RT.EA_arg, Target.Address.size);
441.           CG.Loophole (CG.Type.Addr, t_info.stk_type);
442.           CG.Store_indirect (t_info.stk_type, 0, t_info.size);
443.         END;
444.         Variable.ScheduleTrace (h.var);
445.         oc := Stmt.Compile (h.body);
446.         IF (Stmt.Outcome.FallThrough IN oc) THEN CG.Jump (resume) END;
447.         (* for the debugger's sake, this Jump should be inside the scope *)
448.         Scope.Exit (h.scope);
449.       Scope.Pop (zz);
450.     ELSE
451.       oc := Stmt.Compile (h.body);
452.       IF (Stmt.Outcome.FallThrough IN oc) THEN CG.Jump (resume) END;
453.     END;
454. 
455.     CG.Set_label (top+1);
456.     RETURN oc;
457.   END CompileHandler1;
458.

460.   VAR

289. PROCEDURE Compile (p: P): Stmt.Outcomes =
290.   BEGIN
291.     IF (p.handles = NIL) AND (NOT p.hasElse) THEN
292.       RETURN Stmt.Compile (p.body);
293.     END;
294.     IF Target.Has_stack_walker
295.       THEN RETURN Compile1 (p);
296.       ELSE RETURN Compile2 (p);
297.     END;
298.   END Compile;
299. 
300. PROCEDURE Compile1 (p: P): Stmt.Outcomes =
301.   VAR
302.     oc: Stmt.Outcomes;
303.     l, next_handler, handler_body: CG.Label;
304.     info, next_info: CG.Var;
305.     h: Handler;
306.     another: BOOLEAN;
307.     catches : Caught;
308.   BEGIN
309.     (* declare and initialize the info record *)
310. 
311.     info := CG.Declare_local (M3ID.NoID, Target.Address.size,
312.                               Target.Address.align, CG.Type.Addr, 0,
313.                               in_memory := TRUE, up_level := FALSE,
314.                               f := CG.Never);
315. 
316.     CG.Load_nil ();
317.     CG.Store_addr (info, M3RT.EA_exception);
318. 
319.     (* compile the body *)
320.     l := CG.Next_label (4);
321.     CG.Set_label (l, barrier := TRUE);
322.     CG.Start_try ();
323.     IF (p.hasElse)
324.       THEN Marker.PushTryElse (l, l+1, l+2, info);
325.       ELSE Marker.PushTry (l, l+1, l+2, info, p.handled);
326.     END;
327.     Marker.SaveFrame ();
328.       oc := Stmt.Compile (p.body);
329.     Marker.Pop ();
330. 
331.     IF (Stmt.Outcome.FallThrough IN oc) THEN
332.       CG.Jump (l+3);
333.     END;
334. 
335.     (* End the try block here so handler code is OUTSIDE the try region.
336.        The catch clause generated by End_try jumps to the landing pad (l+1).
337.        Since handler code follows at the same lexical scope, any re-throw
338.        from an unmatched handler is caught by an enclosing outer try block
339.        (if any), not by this one — avoiding the infinite-loop problem. *)
340.     CG.End_try ();

459. PROCEDURE Compile2 (p: P): Stmt.Outcomes =
460.   VAR
461.     oc: Stmt.Outcomes;
462.     h: Handler;
463.     l: CG.Label;
464.     frame, eset: CG.Var;
465.     eoffset: INTEGER;
466.   BEGIN
467.     l := CG.Next_label (3);
468.     CG.Set_label (l, barrier := TRUE);
469. 
470.     (* declare and initialize the info record *)
471.     frame := CG.Declare_local (M3ID.NoID, M3RT.EF1_SIZE, Target.Address.align,
472.                                CG.Type.Struct, 0, in_memory := TRUE,
473.                                up_level := FALSE, f := CG.Never);
474. 
475.     (**********************************************
476.     (* mark the frame: no exception happened yet *)
477.     CG.Load_nil ();
478.     CG.Store_addr (frame, M3RT.EF1_exception);
479.     ***********************************************)
480. 
481.     IF (p.hasElse) THEN
482.       Marker.PushTryElse (l, l+1, 0, frame);
483.       Marker.PushFrame (frame, M3RT.HandlerClass.ExceptElse);
484.     ELSE
485.       Marker.PushTry (l, l+1, 0, frame, p.handled);
486.       ESet.GetAddress (p.handled, eset, eoffset);
487.       CG.Load_addr_of (eset, eoffset, Target.Integer.align);
488.       CG.Store_addr (frame, M3RT.EF1_handles);
489.       Marker.PushFrame (frame, M3RT.HandlerClass.Except);
490.     END;
491. 
492.     (* capture the machine state *)
493.     Marker.CaptureState (frame, Jmpbufs.CompileTryGetJmpbuf (p.jmpbufs), l+1);
494. 
495.     (* compile the body *)
496.     oc := Stmt.Compile (p.body);
497.     Marker.Pop ();
498.     IF (Stmt.Outcome.FallThrough IN oc) THEN
499.       Marker.PopFrame (frame);
500.       CG.Jump (l+2);
501.     END;
502. 
503.     IF (p.hasElse) THEN
504.       (* EXITs and RETURNs from the body are caught by the ELSE clause *)
505.       oc := oc - Stmt.Outcomes {Stmt.Outcome.Returns, Stmt.Outcome.Exits};
506.     END;
507. 
508.     (* set the "Compiler.ThisException()" globals *)
509.     PushHandler (frame, M3RT.EF1_info, direct := TRUE);
510. 
511.     (* compile each of the handlers *)
512.     CG.Set_label (l+1, barrier := TRUE);
513.     Scanner.offset := p.h_origin;
514.     CG.Gen_location (p.h_origin);
515.     h := p.handles;
516.     WHILE (h # NIL) DO
517.       oc := oc + CompileHandler2 (h, frame, l+2,
518.                                   (NOT p.hasElse) AND (h.next = NIL));
519.       h := h.next;
520.     END;
521. 
522.     IF (p.hasElse) THEN
523.       oc := oc + Stmt.Compile (p.elseBody);
524.     END;
525. 
526.     (* restore the "Compiler.ThisException()" globals *)
527.     PopHandler ();
528. 
529.     CG.Set_label (l+2);
530. 
531.     RETURN oc;
532.   END Compile2;
533. 
534. PROCEDURE CompileHandler2 (h: Handler;  frame: CG.Var;
535.                          resume: CG.Label;  last: BOOLEAN): Stmt.Outcomes =
536.   VAR
537.     e: Except;
538.     oc: Stmt.Outcomes;
539.     zz: Scope.T;
540.     top: CG.Label;
541.     need_top := FALSE;
542.     t_info: Type.Info;
543.   BEGIN
544.     top := CG.Next_label (2);
545. 
546.     CG.Gen_location (h.origin);
547. 
548.     IF (NOT last) THEN
549.       (* check for a match *)
550.       e := h.tags;
551.       <*ASSERT e # NIL*>
552.       WHILE (e # NIL) DO
553.         CG.Load_addr
554.           (frame, M3RT.EF1_info + M3RT.EA_exception, Target.Address.align);
555.         CG.Boost_addr_alignment (Target.Integer.align);
556.         CG.Load_indirect (Target.Integer.cg_type, 0, Target.Integer.size);
557.         CG.Load_intt (Exceptionz.UID (e.obj));  (** Value.Load (e.obj);  **)
558.         e := e.next;
559.         IF (e # NIL)
560.           THEN CG.If_compare (Target.Integer.cg_type, CG.Cmp.EQ, top, CG.Maybe);  need_top := TRUE;
```

1929.   VAR
1930.     t_size     := TargetMap.CG_Size [t];
1931.     t_align    := TargetMap.CG_Align [t];
1932.     best_align : Alignment;
1933.     best_size  : Size;
1934.     best_type  : Type;
1935.     fetch_align: INTEGER;

1943. oddStaticBitCt1 : INTEGER;
1944. x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8,x9, x10: ValRec;
1945. 
1946.   BEGIN (* Load_indirect *)
1947. x1 := stack[SCheck(1,"Load_indirect-x1")];
1948.     ForceAddr2SAP (addedOffset);
1949. x2 := stack[SCheck(1,"Load_indirect-x2")];
1950.     WITH x = stack [SCheck (1, "Load_indirect")] DO
1951.       (* x.VKind IN {Stacked, Absolute, Pointer} *) 
1952. a1 := x.addr_align;
1953. 
1954.       IF s = t_size AND x.addr_align MOD t_align = 0 THEN
1955.         (* A full t_size'd and t_align'ed load. *)
1956.         SimpleIndirectLoad (x, t, addr_align);
1957. 
1958.       ELSIF s = t_size  AND x.addr_align MOD Target.Byte = 0
1959.             AND Target.Allow_packed_byte_aligned THEN
1960.         (* A full t_size'd and byte-aligned load, supported by the processor.
1961.            This is used by packed structures. *)
1962.         SimpleIndirectLoad (x, t, addr_align);
1963. 
1964.       ELSIF s > t_size THEN
1965.         Err ("In Load_indirect, memory size exceeds stack size.");
1966.         ForceStacked (); (* to connect the error message with the code *)
1967. x3 := stack[SCheck(1,"Load_indirect-x3")];
1968.         SimpleIndirectLoad (x, t, addr_align);
1969. 
1970.       ELSIF (t = Target.Word.cg_type) OR (t = Target.Integer.cg_type)
1971.             OR (t = Target.Long.cg_type) OR (t = Target.Longint.cg_type)
1972.       THEN
1973.         best_type := MayFindIntType (t, s, x.offset, x.base_value_align);
1974.         IF best_type # Type.Void THEN
1975.  best_type1 := best_type;

546.     CG.Gen_location (h.origin);
547. 
548.     IF (NOT last) THEN
549.       (* check for a match *)
550.       e := h.tags;
551.       <*ASSERT e # NIL*>
552.       WHILE (e # NIL) DO
553.         CG.Load_addr
554.           (frame, M3RT.EF1_info + M3RT.EA_exception, Target.Address.align);
555.         CG.Boost_addr_alignment (Target.Integer.align);
556.         CG.Load_indirect (Target.Integer.cg_type, 0, Target.Integer.size);
557.         CG.Load_intt (Exceptionz.UID (e.obj));  (** Value.Load (e.obj);  **)
558.         e := e.next;
559.         IF (e # NIL)
560.           THEN CG.If_compare (Target.Integer.cg_type, CG.Cmp.EQ, top, CG.Maybe);  need_top := TRUE;
561.           ELSE CG.If_compare (Target.Integer.cg_type, CG.Cmp.NE, top+1, CG.Maybe);
562.         END;
563.       END;
564.       (*** CG.Jump (top+1); ***)
565.     END;
566. 
567.     IF (need_top) THEN CG.Set_label (top) END;
568. 
569.     IF (h.scope # NIL) THEN
570.       zz := Scope.Push (h.scope);
571.         Scope.Enter (h.scope);
572.         Scope.InitValues (h.scope);
573.         Variable.LoadLValue (h.var);
574.         EVAL Type.CheckInfo (h.type, t_info);
575.         IF Exceptionz.ArgByReference (h.type) THEN
576.           CG.Load_addr
577.             (frame, M3RT.EF1_info + M3RT.EA_arg, Target.Address.align);
578.           CG.Boost_addr_alignment (t_info.alignment);
579.           CG.Copy (t_info.size, overlap := FALSE);
580.         ELSE
581.           CG.Load_addr
582.             (frame, M3RT.EF1_info + M3RT.EA_arg, Target.Address.align);
583.           CG.Loophole (CG.Type.Addr, t_info.stk_type);
584.           CG.Store_indirect (t_info.stk_type, 0, t_info.size);
585.         END;
586.         Variable.ScheduleTrace (h.var);
587.         oc := Stmt.Compile (h.body);
588.         IF (Stmt.Outcome.FallThrough IN oc) THEN CG.Jump (resume) END;
589.         (* for the debugger's sake, this Jump should be inside the scope *)
590.         Scope.Exit (h.scope);
591.       Scope.Pop (zz);
592.     ELSE
593.       oc := Stmt.Compile (h.body);
594.       IF (Stmt.Outcome.FallThrough IN oc) THEN CG.Jump (resume) END;
595.     END;
596. 
597.     CG.Set_label (top+1);
598.     RETURN oc;
599.   END CompileHandler2;
600. 
601. PROCEDURE GetOutcome (p: P): Stmt.Outcomes =
602.   VAR h: Handler;  oc := Stmt.GetOutcome (p.body);
603.   BEGIN
604.     IF (p.hasElse) THEN
605.       (* EXITs and RETURNs from the body are caught by the ELSE clause *)
606.       oc := oc - Stmt.Outcomes {Stmt.Outcome.Returns, Stmt.Outcome.Exits};
607.     END;
608. 
609.     h := p.handles;
610.     WHILE (h # NIL) DO
611.       oc := oc + Stmt.GetOutcome (h.body);
612.       h := h.next;
613.     END;
614. 
615.     IF (p.hasElse) THEN
616.       oc := oc + Stmt.GetOutcome (p.elseBody)
617.     END;
618. 
619.     RETURN oc;
620.   END GetOutcome;
621. 
622. (*------------------------------- handler info for Compiler.ThisException ---*)
623. 
624. TYPE
625.   HandlerInfo = RECORD
626.     info   : CG.Var;
627.     offset : INTEGER;
628.     direct : BOOLEAN;
629.   END;
630. 
631. VAR (* for "Compiler.ThisException()" *)
632.   tos   : INTEGER := 0;
633.   stack : ARRAY [0..50] OF HandlerInfo;
634. 
635. PROCEDURE PushHandler (info: CG.Var;  offset: INTEGER;   direct: BOOLEAN) =
636.   BEGIN
637.     WITH z = stack [tos] DO
638.       z.info   := info;
639.       z.offset := offset;
640.       z.direct := direct;

150. 
151.   f->cursor = cursor;

153.   f->sp     = sp;

160. /* PROCEDURE PreviousFrame (READONLY callee: Frame;  VAR(*OUT*) caller: Frame)
161.    Return the stack frame that called "callee".  Returns with pc = NIL if
162.    "callee" is the first frame on the stack or its predecessor is ill-formed.
163.    */
164. 
165. void RTStack__PrevFrame (Frame* callee, Frame* caller)
166. {
167.   unw_word_t ip, sp = 0;
168.   int res;
169. 
170.   if (!callee->cursor)           abort();
171.   if (callee->lock != FrameLock) abort();
172. 
173.   *caller = *callee;
174. 
175.   res = unw_step(caller->cursor);
176.   if (res > 0) {
177.     unw_get_reg(caller->cursor, UNW_REG_IP, &ip);
178.     unw_get_reg(caller->cursor, UNW_REG_SP, &sp);
179. 
180.     caller->pc = ip;
181.     caller->sp = sp;
182.     RTStack__GetProcInfo(caller);
183.   } else {
184.     caller->pc = 0;
185.     caller->sp = 0;
186.   }
187. 
188.   if (caller->lock != FrameLock) abort();
189. }
190. 
191. /*---------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
192. /* PROCEDURE Unwind (READONLY f: Frame);
193.    Restore the machine state back to the frame "f".  All callee-saved
194.    registers must be restored to the state they were in when frame "f"
195.    made its last call. */
196. 
197. void RTStack__Unwind (Frame *target)
198. {
199.   int res;
200. 
201.   if (!target->cursor)           abort();
202.   if (target->lock != FrameLock) abort();
203. 
204.   /* Set IP to the landing pad computed by RTEHScan.ScanEHTable. */
205.   unw_set_reg(target->cursor, UNW_REG_IP, target->landingPad);
206. 
207.   /* Pass the exception object pointer in EH data register 0. */
208.   unw_set_reg(target->cursor,
209.               __builtin_eh_return_data_regno(EHObjRegNo),
210.               target->exceptionRef);
211. 
212.   /* Pass the tTypeIndex (exception selector) in EH data register 1. */
213.   unw_set_reg(target->cursor,
214.               __builtin_eh_return_data_regno(EHTypeRegNo),
215.               target->tTypeIndex);
216. 
217.   res = unw_resume(target->cursor);
218.   /* unw_resume only returns on error. */
219.   if (res < 0) {
220.     printf("RTStack__Unwind - unw_resume error\n");
221.     abort();
222.   }
223. }
224. 
225. #ifdef __cplusplus
226. } /* extern "C" */
227. #endif

The key insight: `CG.Load_addr(v, offset)` loads the **value** of v at that offset, not its address — so `info = ADR(act)` works perfectly for both UID check (double dereference → `act.exception → ExceptionDesc.uid`) and arg loading (`act + EA_arg → act.arg`).

1. (* Copyright (C) 1993, Digital Equipment Corporation           *)
2. (* All rights reserved.                                        *)
3. (* See the file COPYRIGHT for a full description.              *)
4. 
5. UNSAFE MODULE RTExStack EXPORTS RTException;
6. 
7. IMPORT RT0, RTOS, RTError, RTIO, RTStack, RTParams, RTEHScan;
8. IMPORT RTProcedureSRC;
9. FROM RT0 IMPORT RaiseActivation;
10. (*
11. IMPORT Cstring;
12. *)
13. 
14. 
15. VAR
16.   DEBUG := FALSE;
17. 
18. EXCEPTION
19.   OUCH; (* to keep the compiler from complaining *)
20. 
21. TYPE
22.   CharArr = REF ARRAY OF CHAR;
23. 
24. (* The unwinder needs to alloc buffers for the context and the cursor.
25.    Called from the unwinder. *)
26. PROCEDURE AllocBuf(size : INTEGER) : ADDRESS =
27.   VAR arr : CharArr;
28.   BEGIN
29.     arr := NEW(CharArr,size);
30.     RETURN ADR(arr[0]);
31.   END AllocBuf;
32. 
33. PROCEDURE Raise (VAR act: RaiseActivation) RAISES ANY =
34.   VAR
35.     here, f: RTStack.Frame;
36.     excRef : REF RaiseActivation;
37.     scan : BOOLEAN;
38.   BEGIN
39.     IF DEBUG THEN
40.       PutExcept ("RAISE", act);
41.       PrintStack (act.exception.uid);
42.     END;
43. 
44.     RTStack.CurrentFrame (here);
45.     RTStack.PreviousFrame (here, f); (* skip self *)
46.     LOOP
47.       IF (f.pc = NIL) THEN
48.         (* we're at the end of the stack (or we got lost along the way!) *)
49.         InvokeBackstop (act, raises := FALSE);
50.       END;
51. 
52.       IF f.lsda # NIL THEN
53.         (* scan the dwarf eh scopes found by the unwinder *)
54.         scan := RTEHScan.ScanEHTable(f, act.exception.uid);
55.         IF scan THEN
56.           excRef := NEW(REF RaiseActivation);
57.           excRef^ := act;
58.           ResumeRaise (excRef^)
59.         END;
60.       END;
61. 
62.       (* try the previous frame *)
63.       RTStack.PreviousFrame (f, f);
64.     END; (* loop *)
65.   END Raise;
66. 
67. PROCEDURE ResumeRaise (VAR a: RaiseActivation) RAISES ANY =
68.   VAR
69.     here, f: RTStack.Frame;
70.     scan : BOOLEAN;
71.   BEGIN
72.     IF DEBUG THEN
73.       PutExcept ("RERAISE", a);
74.       PrintStack (a.exception.uid);
75.     END;
76. 
77.     RTStack.CurrentFrame (here);
78.     RTStack.PreviousFrame (here, f); (* skip self *)
79.     LOOP
80.       IF (f.pc = NIL) THEN
81.         (* we're at the end of the stack (most likely unhandled exception) *)
82.         InvokeBackstop (a, raises := FALSE);
83.       END;
84. 
85.       IF f.lsda # NIL THEN
86.         (* scan the dwarf eh scopes found by the unwinder *)
87.         scan := RTEHScan.ScanEHTable(f, a.exception.uid);
88.         IF scan THEN
89.           (* landingpad set in scan *)
90.           f.excRef := ADR(a);
91.           RTStack.Unwind (f);
92.           RTError.MsgPC (LOOPHOLE (f.pc, INTEGER), "Unwind returned!");
93.           RAISE OUCH;
94.         END;
95.       END;
96. 
97.       (* try the previous frame *)
98.       RTStack.PreviousFrame (f, f);
99.     END;
100.   END ResumeRaise;
101. 
102. 
103. (*----------------------------------------------------------- diagnostics ---*)
104. 
105. (*
106. VAR NoName := ARRAY [0..15] OF CHAR {'s','t','a','t','i','c',' ',
107.                                      'p','r','o','c','e','d','u','r','e'};
108. *)
109. 
110. PROCEDURE DumpStack () =
111.   BEGIN
112.     PrintStack(0);
113.   END DumpStack;
114. 
115. PROCEDURE PrintStack (uid : INTEGER) =
116.   CONST CallInstructionSize = 8; (* was 4 - should be gotten from Target *)
117.   VAR
118.     here, f: RTStack.Frame;
119.     name: RTProcedureSRC.Name;
120.     scan : BOOLEAN;
121.   BEGIN
122.     RTOS.LockHeap (); (* disable thread switching... (you wish!) *)
123. 
124.     RTIO.PutText ("------------------------- STACK DUMP ---------------------------\n");
125.     RTIO.PutText ("----PC----      ----SP----      --------Procedure--------\n");
126. 
127.     RTStack.CurrentFrame (here);
128.     RTStack.PreviousFrame (here, f); (* skip self *)
129. 
130.     WHILE (f.pc # NIL) DO
131. 
132.       IF f.lsda # NIL THEN
133.         IF uid # 0 THEN
134.           (* scan the dwarf eh scopes found by the unwinder *)
135.           scan := RTEHScan.ScanEHTable(f, uid);
136.           IF scan THEN
137.             (* print the exception stuff. Fixme. Would have to modify
138.                ScanEHTable to take a parameter to dump its debug info. *)
139.           END;
140.         END;
141.       END;
142. 
143.       (* print the procedure's frame *)
144.       (* This is only approximate. The pc will be the one after the call that
145.          results in the chain leading to crash (which prints this trace).
146.          And call instructions can vary in size. *)
147.       RTIO.PutAddr (f.pc - CallInstructionSize, 10);
148.       RTIO.PutText ("  ");
149.       RTIO.PutAddr (f.sp, 10);
150. 
151.       name := RTStack.ProcName (f);
152.       RTIO.PutText ("  [");
153.       IF (name # NIL)
154.         (* not sure why they were checking for "static procedure" probably
155.            an artifact of an old architecture/os *)
156.         (* AND Cstring.memcmp (name, ADR(NoName), NUMBER(NoName)) # 0 *) THEN
157.         RTIO.PutString (name);
158.       END;
159.       RTIO.PutText ("]\n");
160. 
161.       (* try the previous frame *)
162.       RTStack.PreviousFrame (f, f);
163.     END;
164. 
165.     RTIO.PutText ("----------------------------------------------------------------\n");
166.     RTIO.Flush ();
167. 
168.     RTOS.UnlockHeap (); (* re-enable thread switching *)
169.   END PrintStack;
170. 
171. PROCEDURE PutExcept (tag: TEXT;  READONLY a: RaiseActivation) =
172.   BEGIN
173.     RTIO.PutText ("---> ");   RTIO.PutText (tag);
174.     RTIO.PutText (":  en=");  RTIO.PutAddr (a.exception);
175.     RTIO.PutText (" uid=");   RTIO.PutHex (a.exception.uid);
176.     RTIO.Flush ();
177.     RTIO.PutText (" ");       RTIO.PutString (a.exception.name);
178.     RTIO.PutText ("  arg=");  RTIO.PutAddr (a.arg);
179.     RTIO.PutText ("\n  module: ");  RTIO.PutAddr (a.module);
180.     IF (a.module # NIL) AND (a.module.file # NIL) THEN
181.       RTIO.PutText ("  ");          RTIO.PutString (a.module.file);
182.     END;
183.     RTIO.PutText ("\n  line: ");    RTIO.PutInt (a.line);
184.     RTIO.PutText ("   pc: ");       RTIO.PutAddr (a.pc);
185.     RTIO.PutText ("   info0: ");    RTIO.PutAddr (a.info0);
186.     RTIO.PutText ("   info1: ");    RTIO.PutAddr (a.info1);
187.     IF (a.un_except # NIL) THEN
188.       RTIO.PutText ("\n  unhandled: ");
189.       RTIO.PutText (" ");             RTIO.PutString (a.un_except.name);
190.       RTIO.PutText ("  arg=");        RTIO.PutAddr (a.un_arg);
191.     END;
192.     RTIO.PutText ("\n");
193.   END PutExcept;
194. 
195. BEGIN
196.   DEBUG := RTParams.IsPresent ("debugex");
197.   <*ASSERT RTStack.Has_walker*>
198. END RTExStack.
199.
```

<sub>⏱️ 2686m 30s</sub>

### 💬 Copilot

The assert in `exit_proc` was overly conservative — `is_RTException_Raise` implies `no_return`, so `exit_proc` would correctly skip generating a return statement. The old implementation never reached `exit_proc` due to its infinite LOOP, but our new implementation can. The fix is to remove the incorrect assert:

---

292.       RETURN Stmt.Compile (p.body);
293.     END;
294.     IF Target.Has_stack_walker

296.       ELSE RETURN Compile2 (p);
297.     END;
298.   END Compile;
299. 
300. PROCEDURE Compile1 (p: P): Stmt.Outcomes =
301.   VAR
302.     oc: Stmt.Outcomes;
303.     l, next_handler, handler_body: CG.Label;
304.     info, next_info: CG.Var;
305.     h: Handler;
306.     another: BOOLEAN;
307.     catches : Caught;
308.   BEGIN
309.     (* declare and initialize the info record *)
310. 
311.     info := CG.Declare_local (M3ID.NoID, Target.Address.size,
312.                               Target.Address.align, CG.Type.Addr, 0,
313.                               in_memory := TRUE, up_level := FALSE,
314.                               f := CG.Never);
315. 
316.     CG.Load_nil ();
317.     CG.Store_addr (info, M3RT.EA_exception);
318. 
319.     (* compile the body *)
320.     l := CG.Next_label (4);
321.     CG.Set_label (l, barrier := TRUE);
322.     CG.Start_try ();
323.     IF (p.hasElse)
324.       THEN Marker.PushTryElse (l, l+1, l+2, info);
325.       ELSE Marker.PushTry (l, l+1, l+2, info, p.handled);
326.     END;
327.     Marker.SaveFrame ();
328.       oc := Stmt.Compile (p.body);
329.     Marker.Pop ();
330. 
331.     IF (Stmt.Outcome.FallThrough IN oc) THEN
332.       CG.Jump (l+3);
333.     END;
334. 
335.     (* End the try block here so handler code is OUTSIDE the try region.
336.        The catch clause generated by End_try jumps to the landing pad (l+1).
337.        Since handler code follows at the same lexical scope, any re-throw
338.        from an unmatched handler is caught by an enclosing outer try block
339.        (if any), not by this one — avoiding the infinite-loop problem. *)
340.     CG.End_try ();

1. <overview>
2. The user is bootstrapping a native ARM64_DARWIN CM3 (Critical Mass Modula-3) compiler and exploring adding native libunwind-based exception stack unwinding for ARM64_DARWIN. Three bootstrap stages were previously completed (AMD64→ARM64, ARM64 self-hosted, stability verification). This session focused on understanding and beginning to implement the ARM64_DARWIN stack walker, discovering why it cannot be activated without backend code generation changes, and exploring the architectural path forward using m3front's existing `Has_stack_walker` machinery.
3. </overview>
4. 
5. <history>
6. 1. **User asked about ARM64_DARWIN stack walker status**
7.    - Investigation confirmed ARM64_DARWIN has no real stack walker (`Has_stack_walker = FALSE`, all RTStack functions `abort()`)
8.    - Exception handling works via `RTExFrame.m3` (setjmp-based linked list of try frames) — no DWARF EH tables involved
9.    - macOS ARM64 has an excellent libunwind built into `libSystem.B.dylib`; AMD64_LINUX's `RTStackC.c` is the reference implementation
10. 
11. 2. **User asked to add native unwinding for ARM64_DARWIN**
12.    - Created `ARM64_DARWIN/RTMachine.i3` — `Has_stack_walker = TRUE`, `FrameInfo` matching AMD64_LINUX layout
13.    - Created `ARM64_DARWIN/RTStackC.c` — full libunwind implementation using macOS's `libSystem` (no extra link flags needed)
14.    - Created `ARM64_DARWIN/m3makefile` — declares interface and c_source
15.    - Added `"ARM64_DARWIN" : TRUE` to `HAS_STACK_WALKER` in `runtime/m3makefile`
16.    - Added `SYSTEM_LIBS{"UNWIND"} = []` (empty, libunwind in libSystem) and enabled `M3_USE_STACK_WALKER = TRUE` in `~/cm3/bin/config/ARM64_DARWIN`
17.    - Built and shipped m3core — compiled successfully with ex_stack path
18.    - Built a test program exercising exception handling; it **hung indefinitely**
19. 
20. 3. **User identified root cause: exception tables not generated by compiler**
21.    - Investigation confirmed `start_try`, `end_try`, `invoke_direct`, `invoke_indirect`, `landing_pad` are **all stubs in M3C.m3** — no C code emitted
22.    - The C backend uses setjmp exclusively; no `.gcc_except_table` LSDA sections are generated by clang for M3-compiled code
23.    - `RTExStack.Raise` loops forever because `f.lsda = 0` for every frame (no EH tables → no landing pads found)
24.    - Reverted `M3_USE_STACK_WALKER` to commented-out in ARM64_DARWIN config
25.    - Rebuilt m3core with ex_frame (setjmp-based), discovered stale RTExStack objects in archive — needed full `cm3 -clean` + rebuild
26.    - Added `SYSTEM_LIBS{"UNWIND"} = []` unconditionally (so `import_sys_lib("UNWIND")` in runtime m3makefile always resolves)
27.    - Verified exception handling works correctly again with ex_frame
28. 
29. 4. **User asked about using m3front's `Has_stack_walker` machinery with libunwind**
30.    - Explored m3front source: when `Target.Has_stack_walker = TRUE`, m3front generates `invoke_direct`/`invoke_indirect` (not `call_direct`) for calls inside TRY blocks, and `landing_pad` with exception UID arrays at handler entry points
31.    - `Marker.m3`, `TryStmt.m3`, `TryFinStmt.m3`, `Procedure.m3` all have two code paths: `Compile1` (stack walker) and `Compile2`/`Compile3` (setjmp)
32.    - The IR is correct and complete — m3front passes `handler` labels, catches arrays with exception UIDs — but M3C.m3 ignores all of it
33.    - Key gap: M3 exceptions are raised by calling `RTException__Raise()` (a C function), not via C++ `throw`, so C++ `try/catch(...)` cannot intercept them unless the raise mechanism also changes
34.    - Conversation ended while exploring the architectural path forward
35. </history>

335.     (* End the try block here so handler code is OUTSIDE the try region.
336.        The catch clause generated by End_try jumps to the landing pad (l+1).
337.        Since handler code follows at the same lexical scope, any re-throw
338.        from an unmatched handler is caught by an enclosing outer try block
339.        (if any), not by this one — avoiding the infinite-loop problem. *)
340.     CG.End_try ();
341. 
342.     IF (p.hasElse) THEN
343.       (* EXITs and RETURNs from the body are caught by the ELSE clause *)
344.       oc := oc - Stmt.Outcomes {Stmt.Outcome.Returns, Stmt.Outcome.Exits};
345.     END;
346. 
347.     (* check for enclosing handlers *)
348.     another := Marker.NextHandler (next_handler, handler_body, next_info);
349. 
350.     (* set the "Compiler.ThisException()" globals *)
351.     PushHandler (info, 0, direct := FALSE);
352. 
353.     CG.Set_label (l+1, barrier := TRUE);
354.     Scanner.offset := p.h_origin;
355.     CG.Gen_location (p.h_origin);
356. 
357.     (* generate the landing pad *)
358.     catches := Handled(p);
359.     CG.Landing_pad (l+1, catches^);
360.     CG.Store_addr (info);
```

readonly HAS_STACK_WALKER = {
% "ALPHA_OSF"  : TRUE,

% "SOLgnu"     : TRUE,
% "SOLsun"     : TRUE,
 "AMD64_LINUX"   : TRUE,
--
%    else

if defined("M3_USE_STACK_WALKER")
  if M3_USE_STACK_WALKER and HAS_STACK_WALKER contains TARGET

      include_dir("ex_stack")
      include_dir(TARGET)
      import_sys_lib ("UNWIND")
    else
      include_dir("ex_frame")
    end
  else
    include_dir("ex_frame")
  end
else
  include_dir("ex_frame")
end

4363.     INC(self.index);

4367. BEGIN
4368.     MarkUsed_label(self, label);
4369. END MarkUsed_if_true;
4370.

4382. BEGIN
4383.     FOR i := FIRST(labels) TO LAST(labels) DO
4384.         MarkUsed_label(self, labels[i]);

4389. BEGIN

4391. END CountUsedLabels_case_jump;
